description: This file defines the AndroidKeyStore class which provides methods for interacting with the Android KeyStore, including checking support for cryptographic algorithms, signing messages, and encrypting data using private keys. It interfaces with native code and uses Java security APIs.

classes.name: AndroidKeyStore
classes.description: Provides methods to interact with Android KeyStore, including support checks, signing, and encryption with private keys.

methods.name: getPrivateKeyClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name of the provided PrivateKey object.

methods.name: privateKeySupportsSignature
methods.description: Checks if a PrivateKey supports a specified signature algorithm.

methods.name: privateKeySupportsCipher
methods.description: Checks if a PrivateKey supports a specified cipher algorithm.

methods.name: signWithPrivateKey
methods.description: Signs a message with a PrivateKey using a specified algorithm.

methods.name: encryptWithPrivateKey
methods.description: Encrypts data with a PrivateKey using a specified cipher algorithm.
